common.description: Rent aircraft from verified owners across Europe. Pilots, owners, technicians and airports in one place.

footer.tagline: Made for general aviation in Europe.

home.title: Rent a plane. Fly more.
home.subtitle: Find verified aircraft to rent near you and book with owners who can see your ratings. Hiring technicians and requesting airport services will follow, all in one place.

pilots.title: Pilots
pilots.text: Search aircraft near you by dates, see specs, price per hour and availability, and send a booking request.

owners.title: Owners
owners.text: List your aircraft, manage its calendar and decide who flies it with a minimum pilot rating and experience rules.

technicians.title: Technicians
technicians.text: Offer 50 h and 100 h checks and other maintenance to owners nearby.

airports.title: Airports
airports.text: Take PPR, apron parking, hangar, fuel and customs requests online.

home.trustEasa: Built for EASA rules and European airfields
home.accountDeleted: Your account and all its data have been deleted.

search.text: Search aircraft by airport, dates and specs.

pilot.title: Pilot credentials
pilot.description: Add your licence, medical and ratings. We check them against your documents, usually within two working days.
pilot.privacy: Owners only see which licence and ratings are verified. Numbers, documents and medical details are visible only to you and our verification team.
pilot.notPilotText: Turn on the pilot role to add your licence and rent aircraft.

licences.title: Licences

errors.changed: The pilot changed this item since you opened the page. Please check it again.

aircraftReview.checklist: Check that each document is for {registration}, is readable and valid, and that the expiry date matches. For insurance, check it covers rental. Opening a document is logged.

page.notPublic: This aircraft isn't listed, so only you (and our team) can see this page.

sectionText.pricing: Price per hour and your cancellation terms. Payment is arranged directly with the pilot.

sectionText.documents: We check these before the aircraft can be listed. Only you and our team can see them.
sectionText.requirements: Decide who can rent the aircraft. Pilots see this on the listing.

details.registrationHint: As painted on the aircraft, e.g. LZ-ABC.

details.icaoTypeHint: Used to match pilots' hours on type, e.g. C172 or P28A.

equipment.ifrHint: Equipped and approved for instrument flights.

base.homeBaseHint: Search by ICAO code (e.g. LBSF), name or city.

documents.intro: Upload a scan or photo of each document. We check that they match the registration.

hints.cofa: Or the permit to fly / national certificate for ultralights.
hints.arc: Must be valid. When it expires, the aircraft is unlisted automatically.
hints.insurance: Must cover rental to other pilots and be valid. When it expires, the aircraft is unlisted automatically.

files.title: Documents for renters
files.description: POH/AFM extract, checklists and weight & balance. Only pilots with an accepted booking will see them (once booking opens).

requirements.minReviews: Reviews needed to count as rated
requirements.minReviewsHint: Pilots with fewer reviews are "not rated yet".
requirements.privilegesHint: Night or IR are also checked for each night or IFR flight.
requirements.typeRatingsHint: ICAO type designators, separated by commas, e.g. C510.
requirements.emptyMeansNone: Leave a field empty for no minimum.

status.deleteText: The listing, its photos and documents will be deleted permanently.
status.incomplete: Some information is still missing: see the list above.
status.paused: Paused. Pilots can't find it until you list it again.
status.listed: Listed! Pilots can now find your aircraft.
status.publishRequested: Thanks! It goes live as soon as we've checked the documents.

overview.title: Status
overview.bookingsSoon: Pilots will be able to send booking requests soon. Until then, your listing is visible on your public profile.
overview.docExpired: {name} expired on {date}: upload the new one
overview.listed: Listed since {date}. Pilots can find it.
overview.paused: Paused: hidden from pilots. List it again at any time.
overview.grounded: Grounded: can't be booked until the defect is fixed.
overview.unlistedExpired: Unlisted automatically because the ARC or insurance expired. Upload the new document; after our check you can list it again.
overview.publishRequested: Goes live automatically as soon as we've checked the documents.
overview.draftReady: Everything is ready. Publish to let pilots find it.
